workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
the end mark is a chip holding a U+2060 word joiner, since a chip of spaces prints its markup

headings.balancing.stretchAfterFloats is off: on a story's closing page under a page-wide top float, the lever drops the shorter column a line, out of line with the other (gotcha float-stretch-closing-page); switched off on every page as a guard for edited copy, since the shipped copy does not trip it
exact hyphenation codes 'en-us' and 'es': a regional tag such as 'es-ES' falls back to American English (gotcha hyphenation-locales)

the end mark is ink because a section palette does not reach chip colours: a lake chip would stay teal on the field guide's rust page (pipeline/partPalette.ts recolours segment colours, not chip boxes)
design text lineHeight is given as multiples of the size (0.94, 1.22): a pt() value silently drops the opener's reserved height in 1.4.1 (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)
